workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad. I've checked Priya and Marcus's calendars. Times when BOTH are free: Mon 9:00-10:00, Tue 13:00-14:00 or 16:30-17:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, Thu 10:00-10:30, Fri 11:00-12:00. Please check Elena and David against these slots and tell me which work for all four.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I checked Elena and David's calendars against the slots you provided. Unfortunately, NONE of them work for both Elena and David. Here's why:

- Mon 9:00-10:00: Elena busy (Contract review + Recruiting call), David busy (Quarterly planning + Recruiting call)
- Tue 13:00-14:00: Elena busy (Quarterly planning + Contract review), David busy (Client call + Busy)
- Tue 16:30-17:00: Elena busy (Hiring panel), David busy (Travel)
- Wed 15:00-16:00: David busy entire hour (Partner lunch + Busy)
- Thu 10:00-10:30: Elena busy (Hiring panel)
- Fri 11:00-12:00: Elena busy (Client dinner prep + 1:1), David busy (Training + Litigation strategy)

Here are the times when BOTH Elena and David are free - please check if Priya and Marcus are available at any of these:
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

We need a 30-minute slot from one of these options.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks Brad. I checked Priya and Marcus against your slots. The only time all four are free is **Thursday 14:30-15:00**. Priya and Marcus are both free that half-hour, and you confirmed Elena and David are free 14:30-15:30. I'll create the booking for Thursday at 14:30.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Booking created successfully: Thursday 14:30-15:00. Brad, please send the confirmation email to all four partners to complete the task.
